title: Automation watchdog child-process regression
scope: Full tests/AutomationWatchdog.Tests.ps1 run after disabling Pester TestRegistry; 16 discovered cases.

result.frameworkTeardown: Pester could not delete TestDrive because host-worker-errors.log was still open.

failedTests.name: terminates an inert preparation hang and writes a terminal timeout without a recovery block
failedTests.reason: Process-tree termination exceeded the ten-second bound; RecoveryRequired was true instead of false.

failedTests.name: terminates an inert descendant as well as its request parent
failedTests.reason: Process-tree termination exceeded the ten-second bound; RecoveryRequired was true instead of false.

failedTests.name: bounds a recovery hang and blocks further work after possible VM changes
failedTests.reason: The worker child remained alive after process-tree termination exceeded the ten-second bound.

resolved: Thirteen watchdog cases passed, including repeated real-child progress updates, correlated success and failure, child exit without a result, and explicit blocking when process-tree termination could not be confirmed.
deferred: The three timeout/recovery cases need process-tree termination support that completes within the watchdog bound in this host environment.
partial: The watchdog suite is not accepted because three process termination cases failed and Pester TestDrive teardown encountered an open worker log. No migration outcome closes.

estimates.changeReason: No legacy outcome closed; ranges remain unchanged.

blockers: Three watchdog process termination scenarios exceed the ten-second process-tree bound in the current host environment.
Pester teardown could not remove the temporary TestDrive while host-worker-errors.log was open.
RIDE-Win11-Test acceptance remains blocked by host CIM access.
